sentences.text: At the very outset, learned Standing Counsel, on the basis of instructions received, stated that an FIR has been lodged in the instant case, which was registered as Case Crime No.454 of 2023, under Sections 363/366/376 IPC and 5/6 POCSO, Police Station Soron, District Kasganj, therefore, the writ petition has become infructuous.
3. Learned counsel for the petitioners does not dispute the aforesaid facts.
4. Accordingly, the writ petition is dismissed as infructuous.
